rules.providerOnboarding: No provider with a publicly stated KYB/KYC requirement
rules.branchCreation: Registered queued releases may be prepared on private branches. Only the active release may ship; integrate current main and reverify before activation.
rules.staging: Gate-passed private previews must be isolated and access-restricted. Production-connected staging services must not be repurposed for unfinished work.

releases.shipGate: Fresh Uniswap quote and successful simulation; all user-paid costs are disclosed; official-app handoff requotes; no signing method exists.

releases.outcome: Use ChainScout without becoming a profile
releases.shipGate: Private Mode needs no account; browser tokens are not readable by JavaScript; private fields never enter logs, analytics, or saved server records; legacy cloud data can be exported and deleted.
Lots, notes, photos, and purchase prices are encrypted in IndexedDB with tested export, import, lock, recovery, deletion, and storage-eviction states; plaintext never crosses the network.

releases.outcome: See holdings, performance, activity, and risk together
releases.shipGate: Balances, NFTs, transactions, approvals, and decoded movements reconcile against one captured current block whose hash is rechecked; the non-final anchor and bounded coverage are explicit; manual lot math is deterministic; saved ownership context remains encrypted and browser-local.

releases.outcome: Understand tokenized assets, yield, and physical claims
releases.shipGate: Stock Token identity, multipliers, corporate actions, oracle freshness, Morpho vault state, custody claims, and redemption limits are source-linked; unsupported authenticity is never inferred.

releases.outcome: Add cards and collectibles without a spreadsheet
releases.shipGate: A field-selective TCGdex GraphQL request resolves English card ID, set, collector number, category, rarity, and illustrator without requesting artwork, marketplace pricing, or printing metadata. Owner-supplied printing or variant, condition, grade, certificate, locally sanitized photo, and dated manual value source are explicitly labeled and encrypted locally; none is treated as provider-verified authenticity, current market data, or inventory. Manual assets remain usable without a match or provider.

releases.outcome: Compare fresh liquidity, prices, stock, and available product/source signals
releases.shipGate: Exact-match confidence, source freshness, landed-cost inputs, inventory state, and provider-reported product signals are visible; missing seller reputation is explicit and unsupported venues use precise search handoffs instead of scraping.

releases.outcome: Rebuild a trade or purchase safely
releases.shipGate: Historical calldata and checkout data are never reused; users choose a new amount or offer; official Uniswap or merchant checkout independently requotes and owns execution.

releases.outcome: Reuse ChainScout's reviewed public support data
releases.shipGate: The capped API exposes a two-entry reviewed static support registry plus independently derived syntax normalization; it contains no Vault data or restricted upstream payloads and cannot create paid overage.

releases.outcome: Certify the enabled private asset command center for launch
releases.shipGate: End-to-end launch journeys pass on desktop and mobile; dependency, privacy, accessibility, provider-failure, load, legal-copy, backup, deletion, monitoring, and rollback gates are complete.

releases.outcome: Understand discovered spending permissions and prepare a safe external revocation
releases.shipGate: Current ERC20, ERC721 and operator permissions are anchored, source-linked and explicitly bounded by discovery coverage; revoked, unknown and unavailable are distinct; no safety verdict or exhaustive scan is implied. External revocation requires a verified chain-supported destination, explicit disclosure of network costs and user-controlled execution; ChainScout never signs or broadcasts.

releases.outcome: Compare private trade scenarios and their portfolio effects without executing
releases.shipGate: Fresh supported quotes drive exact before/after quantities, allocation assumptions and disclosed costs; stale, unsupported, insufficient-balance and failed-quote states are tested. Saved scenarios are encrypted locally. Quote previews are not described as guaranteed execution or full transaction simulation; official tools independently requote and own execution.

releases.currentSlice: Card Price Check: standalone public reference prices only. Automatic live offers and sold-listing aggregation remain access-restricted and unshipped; the listing ship gate below is not claimed complete.
releases.outcome: Compare exact collectible offers and evidence without confusing asking prices with value
releases.shipGate: Supported authorized free-tier sources distinguish printing, condition and grade, list known landed costs and timestamp every offer. Sold-price evidence is independently labeled and never fabricated; unknown shipping and weak matches cannot rank as guaranteed cheapest. Provider limits fail closed without overage; unsupported venues use explicit search handoffs rather than claimed live listings.

releases.outcome: Save wallets privately and see what changed between checks
releases.shipGate: Wallet labels and bounded snapshot history are encrypted locally. User-triggered public-address refreshes show exact comparable balance changes and newly observed activity with block anchors, source links and coverage gaps; missing is never zero, transfers are not inferred trades, and no background monitoring or profit claims are made. Persistence, backup/restore, deletion, stale/reorg/provider errors, concurrency, accessibility and English/Chinese mobile flows are tested. No signing, new provider, recurring vendor cost or private-data upload is introduced.
